purpose: Carry landing metadata for automatic launchable operations while the command catalog remains the allowlist authority.
migration_rule: Inline these contracts into system/lib/launchable_operations.py once catalog ownership is clean; until then, validators may merge this overlay for reporting and staged enforcement, but launchers must still resolve commands from the catalog.

residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger capture when refresh exits nonzero or leaves owner-visible stale sources

result_landing_contract.produces: Refreshed or verified-current embedding cache rows for the requested source kind.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: kernel.embed_refresh result_summary.error_count == 0 with a stable_signal_digest; embed-status reports the refreshed source.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: kernel.embed_refresh returns nonzero, includes an error row, or embed-status still reports stale owner data.

residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger capture or metabolism doctor row when the navigation source remains stale

result_landing_contract.produces: Refreshed navigation-relevant embedding cache rows for the requested source kind.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: kernel.embed_refresh result_summary.error_count == 0; downstream policy may enqueue semantic_route_refresh for the same source.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: Refresh error, unchanged stale source, or missing downstream route-refresh enqueue receipt.

residual_routing.primary: metabolismd job/run receipt or reactions event receipt
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger route/staleness capture when route_status remains stale or route_refresh exits nonzero

result_landing_contract.produces: Refreshed semantic route graph, status, drift, and evidence-summary projections for the requested source kind.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: kernel.route_refresh emits graph/status/drift paths, result_summary, and stable_signal_digest; route-status reflects the new route graph fingerprint.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: Skipped low disk headroom, nonzero route refresh, stale sources remain, or drift count requires owning-route review.

residual_routing.primary: metabolismd job/run receipt plus nvidia_runtime batch ledger
residual_routing.provider_blocked: metabolism doctor/provider budget row and Task Ledger provider-pressure capture when NVIDIA is unavailable or throttled
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger capture when selected source kinds remain stale after the bounded batch

result_landing_contract.produces: One bounded NVIDIA embedding-population batch over selected stale navigation sources, optionally followed by route refresh.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: nvidia_runtime result ok=true with artifact_refs, result_summary.error_count == 0, and batch_finished ledger entry.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: Provider unavailable, provider budget veto, batch status failed, source-level error row, or route_refresh skipped/failed.

residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Missed captures retire before fetch; provider/data failures retained separately from model scores.

result_landing_contract.produces: Timestamped public market observations and explicit quality or failure receipts.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: Current fire collected, artifact timestamps and per-symbol coverage preserved.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: Missed window, unavailable feed or model, incomplete scoring truth.
